contracts: vdd.semantic-plan-bundle.v1

(A fresh-checkout evaluation from the pinned inputs yields the same semantic verdict; any mismatch is unsuccessful.) AND (A substituted target is rejected before replay or inspection can use it.) AND (A successful Replay Result exposes independent target verification, and missing, substituted, or mismatched target binding prevents success.) AND (A successful Replay Result is retained only when its receipt contains an independently verified Consumer binding for the executed call; absent, self-reported, or unexecuted Consumer evidence is rejected.) AND (A wrong target binding produces an invalid aggregate rather than an acceptable aggregate.) AND (Each applicable Consumer has a real-call rollback receipt whose route identity, verdict, and diagnostic category equal its captured Prior Behavior Baseline.) AND (Every applicable Consumer's re-enable transition invokes the real Candidate Route and exposes its current execution result.) AND (No inspection result is accepted unless an independent observed-read witness establishes that the intended target was effectively inspected.) AND (S7 测试确认成功 Replay Result 记录独立依赖验证。) AND (The FR-10 selector observes a successful real Candidate Route invocation for enable; an absent, simulated, or configuration-only invocation fails.) AND (The S24 selector accepts candidate-external trust only when distinct independent verification evidence is complete and not candidate-controlled or inherited.) AND (The S24 selector accepts the fresh-checkout evaluation only when its semantic verdict and coverage result equal the pinned-input evaluation.) AND (The S7 selector fails if any adversarial dependency case receives a success verdict or lacks a rejection reason.) AND (The S7 selector rejects a Stable Package without a verifiable provenance reference and rejects a merely different temporary package; only source-supported existing behavior with a bound immutable provenance reference is eligible.) AND (The S7 selector reports a non-acceptable invalid aggregate whenever matrix evidence is mislabeled.) AND (The S7 selector reports an invalid aggregate attributable to copied matrix evidence, and no acceptance-eligible aggregate is emitted.) AND (The aggregate evaluator emits an invalid terminal decision for missing required matrix evidence and no acceptance-success outcome is possible.) AND (The inspected artifact contains a non-empty declaration identifying the platform-specific behavior and platform context.) AND (The isolation check establishes independent attribution for every listed component and rejects a cross-component mutable evidence substitution before it can produce success.) AND (The original binding is reconstructed, the replay uses the same identity, identity mismatch is rejected, historical evidence is unchanged, and a fresh process replay is attributable to the pinned identities.) AND (The pre-review validation accepts only a non-empty Consumer Manifest reconciled bidirectionally with every repository caller, including VDD, Acceptance, and workflow-model-routing, and proves its frozen lifecycle state precedes review.) AND (对抗性 validator case 的评估结果不是 success 且包含拒绝诊断；返回 success 即失败。) AND (验证输出明确为非 success 且诊断指出 reused evidence；任何 success 结果均为失败。)
